snapshots.notes: Traffic is Ubersuggest's Sep 2026 estimate: 1,014, down from 1,163 in Aug and 2,076 in Aug 2025. Organic keywords rose to 5,283 (from 4,699): more terms, fewer clicks, the same pattern as the baseline. Top-tier keywords fell from 24 to 22. Most Day 1-11 articles went live in the second half of September, so they barely show in a September estimate. DATA WARNING: a 7-day window (09-24 to 10-01) showed 49 of 91 not ranking. That was a partial 09-30 collection (has_gap/unstable), not a collapse; the 30-day window used here shows 13. Always use the 30-day window. The 4-10 bin fell from 29 to 21 (the leading indicator), mostly from #8-9 slipping to #10-12 (dinosaur hoodie 8->11, purses 8->11, adult dinosaur shirt 9->12).

Moves of 5+ (09-08 -> latest): dinosaur hat 11->3, dinosaur purses 16->11, dinosaur handbag 36->31, dinosaur bucket hat 18->14; dinosaur blanket 23->28, dinosaur christmas ornament 29->35, dinosaur tote bag 8->13. Treat these as unconfirmed until the 10-07 collection; re-check next Monday.

traffic_history._comment: 13-month trend from the baseline pull. Peak Aug 2025 (2,076) -> Jul 2026 (1,141), a ~45% decline while ranked keyword count rose.

leading_indicator._comment: Tracked keywords in positions 4-10. Moves before traffic does. Populate on the first Monday rank pull.

90_day.basis: return to Aug 2025 level via seasonal cluster + first rescues

180_day.basis: assumes rescue briefs approved and shipped steadily; halve if rescues stay blocked
